capabilities.name: Company settings and preferences
capabilities.purpose: Explain and control the fiscal, numbering, currency, class, department, and inventory settings that shape all later records.
capabilities.tierRationale: Transactions and reports cannot be interpreted safely without their governing company preferences.

applicability.notes: General Preferences support is documented; the exact connected-company values and Canada-specific writable fields are not yet verified.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Per-field API Explorer review plus read-only Preferences observation and manual QBO settings comparison.
limitations: General documentation does not prove that every preference is writable in Canada or by the current app.

capabilities.name: Chart of accounts
capabilities.purpose: Provide the deliberate account structure needed for believable transactions and financial statements.
capabilities.tierRationale: The chart of accounts is the accounting spine for every lifecycle and critical financial report.

applicability.notes: Account is a documented Accounting API resource; Canada subtype and close constraints still require classification.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Review the Account API operations and subtype rules, then compare the proposed blueprint against a read-only company inventory.
limitations: No business-specific chart of accounts is implemented.

capabilities.name: Customers and customer hierarchy
capabilities.purpose: Represent recognizable customer segments, terms, provinces, sub-customers, contacts, and payment behaviour.
capabilities.tierRationale: Receivables, sales analysis, projects, and manual support reproduction depend on coherent customers.

applicability.notes: Customer is a documented list entity; variants and Canada fields need per-entity review.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Per-operation API Explorer review, deterministic fixture review, then paginated sandbox read observation.
limitations: Current seeding creates generic names and does not model stable customer behaviour.

capabilities.name: Vendors and terms
capabilities.purpose: Represent supplier segments, contacts, payment terms, tax details, and purchasing behaviour.
capabilities.tierRationale: Payables and purchasing reports require coherent vendors and terms.

applicability.notes: Vendor is a documented list entity; Canadian tax-identifier handling remains unverified.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Per-operation API Explorer review, fixture review, then paginated sandbox read observation.
limitations: Current seeding creates generic vendors without persistent behavioural segments.

capabilities.name: Products, services, bundles, and inventory
capabilities.purpose: Exercise service, non-inventory, inventory, category, bundle, quantity, valuation, and purchasing behaviour.
capabilities.tierRationale: The approved business shape and inventory reports require items with correct account relationships and lifecycle effects.

applicability.notes: Inventory is product/preference dependent; the official guide documents item types and inventory behaviour but the connected preference is not yet observed.

preferences: Quantity on hand enabled for inventory

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Official guide and API Explorer review, then read-only Preferences observation and sandbox lifecycle/accounting fixtures.
limitations: Current app creates service items only; no coherent inventory lifecycle exists.

capabilities.name: Sales and receivables lifecycle
capabilities.purpose: Create linked estimates, invoices, sales receipts, payments, credits, refunds, deposits, and realistic open states.
capabilities.tierRationale: Receivables are a central business lifecycle and feed multiple critical reports.

applicability.notes: Core transaction resources are documented; exact operations, links, tax behaviour, and regional variants require entity-level review.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Entity-by-entity operation/link review, deterministic accounting fixtures, sandbox idempotency tests, and report assertions.
limitations: Current generation covers only narrow randomized AR chains and is not resumable.

capabilities.name: Purchases and payables lifecycle
capabilities.purpose: Create linked purchase orders where supported, bills, expenses, payments, vendor credits, and realistic open states.
capabilities.tierRationale: Payables are a central business lifecycle and feed cash, expense, and liability reporting.

applicability.notes: Bill and BillPayment are documented transaction resources; purchase-order and regional details require current review.

preferences: Bills and purchase orders if applicable

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Entity-by-entity operation/link review, deterministic accounting fixtures, sandbox idempotency tests, and report assertions.
limitations: Current generation covers only narrow randomized AP chains and does not model a durable purchasing narrative.

capabilities.name: Banking, cash movement, and cleared state
capabilities.purpose: Represent bank and credit-card accounts, deposits, transfers, purchases, statement periods, and cleared/uncleared activity.
capabilities.tierRationale: Cash flow, balance sheet, close, and reconciliation cannot be credible without explainable bank activity.

applicability.notes: Candidate surface requires entity and product review; bank-feed automation is not assumed.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Official entity review, manual product review, sandbox accounting fixtures, and manual reconciliation evidence.
limitations: No bank-feed import or official reconciliation automation is assumed.

capabilities.name: Canadian sales and purchase tax
capabilities.purpose: Represent internally consistent GST, HST, PST, exempt, zero-rated, and out-of-scope treatment across provinces.
capabilities.tierRationale: Canadian tax treatment changes transactions, balances, close work, and critical support/report scenarios.

applicability.notes: The platform documents distinct non-US tax behaviour; the exact Canada API and filing surface is not yet classified.

entitlements: Restricted Sales Tax API scope if justified

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Current official non-US/Canada documentation review, Canada sandbox observations, reviewed tax fixtures, and report assertions.
limitations: No tax code, filing, or payment write is approved from the current evidence.

capabilities.name: Projects and project-linked activity
capabilities.purpose: Represent project customers, project estimates, sales, purchases, time/cost, and profitability where entitled.
capabilities.tierRationale: A service/project line is part of the approved flagship business and must have honest product/API coverage.

applicability.notes: Official documentation says Projects and Project API support Advanced, but API access also requires a paid Intuit partner tier, restricted scope, and Projects enabled in company preferences.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Verify current app partner tier and scopes without printing credentials, read ProjectsEnabled, then use separately approved sandbox fixtures.
limitations: Product entitlement alone does not grant the app access to the premium Project API.

capabilities.name: Journal entries and period close
capabilities.purpose: Represent reviewed accruals, deferrals, depreciation, payroll summaries, corrections, retained earnings, and closed-period rules.
capabilities.tierRationale: A continual company and meaningful financial statements require recurring month-end accounting.

applicability.notes: JournalEntry is documented; Canada close settings and exact period protections need current verification.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: API Explorer review, golden debit/credit fixtures, closed-period contract tests, and sandbox report assertions.
limitations: The current random journal generation is not a reviewed close lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Bank and credit-card reconciliation
capabilities.purpose: Track statement periods, cleared activity, differences, adjustments, reviewer evidence, and official QBO confirmation honestly.
capabilities.tierRationale: Reconciliation is essential to a believable continual company even if the official action is UI-only.

applicability.notes: No Accounting API reconciliation endpoint was established in the initial official-source pass; absence is not yet classified as unsupported.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Official product/API review followed by a manual QBO procedure and evidence design; do not infer official completion from transaction flags.
limitations: No official QBO reconciliation state may be claimed until the surface is verified.

capabilities.name: Budgets and comparisons
capabilities.purpose: Provide business targets that make management and budget-versus-actual reports meaningful.
capabilities.tierRationale: Budgets broaden Advanced and management-report coverage after the accounting spine is stable.

applicability.notes: Product and API availability remain a Phase 1 research item.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Current product and API documentation review, manual UI inventory, then fixture/report validation.
limitations: No budget automation or report endpoint is currently established.

capabilities.name: Classes, locations/departments, and other dimensions
capabilities.purpose: Create enough dimension variation for operational analysis, filtering, and Advanced feature coverage.
capabilities.tierRationale: Dimensions materially broaden reports but depend on the core accounts, entities, and transactions.

applicability.notes: Official Preferences fields document class and department tracking flags; connected-company settings remain unobserved.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Preferences and entity API review, read-only setting observation, then sandbox dimension/report fixtures.
limitations: Settings availability does not prove representative dimensional data exists.

capabilities.name: QBO company users and roles
capabilities.purpose: Track expected company users, custom roles, access boundaries, verification dates, evidence, and manual procedures.
capabilities.tierRationale: Users and roles are P0 coverage but must not be conflated with Test Data Lab authorization.

applicability.notes: The initial official Accounting API pass did not establish a company-user administration entity.

entitlements: Appropriate QBO company administrator authority for manual verification

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Current official product and API review plus manual QBO user/role inventory; never infer QBO role from app role.
limitations: Application agent/supervisor roles are not evidence of QBO company roles.

capabilities.name: Reports API and evidence normalization
capabilities.purpose: Retrieve supported reports, preserve parameters and freshness, normalize results, and validate relationships without flattening meaningful states.
capabilities.tierRationale: Broad meaningful report coverage is a primary release outcome.

applicability.notes: The Reports API is documented generally; exact Canada availability and endpoint/UI parity remain report-level questions.

transactions: At least two relevant periods where comparisons apply

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Official endpoint review, fixture normalization tests, sandbox retrieval, cross-report assertions, and manual UI comparison.
limitations: A successful request is only availability evidence, not coverage.

capabilities.name: API rate, batch, and operation budgets
capabilities.purpose: Keep interactive reads and bounded operations inside documented limits while exposing throttling and stopping before unsafe volume.
capabilities.tierRationale: Every large historical or continual operation depends on measured, enforced realm-level budgets.

applicability.notes: Published sandbox and Production REST limits apply per realm/app, but the official batch pages currently disagree on payload guidance.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Resolve the official batch guidance conflict, add static budget tests, then run an explicitly approved sandbox benchmark below published ceilings.
limitations: The batch guide says up to 10 payloads while the current limits page recommends at most 30; use neither as an approved application budget until reconciled.
Published ceilings are not a target throughput profile.

capabilities.name: Full QBO data pagination
capabilities.purpose: Inspect every in-scope record rather than treating a 100-row response as a complete catalog.
capabilities.tierRationale: Coverage, drift, provenance, and governed management cannot be trusted from truncated entity sets.

applicability.notes: The official query language documents STARTPOSITION/MAXRESULTS, a default of 100, and a maximum of 1,000 entities per response.

capabilities.evidenceMethod: Static query adapter tests plus an explicitly approved read-only pagination benchmark.
limitations: The current explorer uses a 100-row cap and does not prove completeness.

reports.name: Balance Sheet
reports.businessQuestion: What does the company own, owe, and retain at the end of a period?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; Canada/connected-company validation is pending.

assertions: Assets equal liabilities plus equity within the documented rounding tolerance.
Receivable and payable totals agree to related aging controls within documented scope.

reports.name: Profit and Loss
reports.businessQuestion: How much did the company earn and spend during a period?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; Canada/connected-company validation is pending.

expectedNonZero: COGS when inventory is in scope
assertions: Net income equals income less cost of goods sold and expenses within tolerance.
Period results align with the blueprint's cadence and seasonality bands.

reports.name: Trial Balance
reports.businessQuestion: Do account debit and credit balances form a complete balanced ledger at a point in time?

applicability.notes: The official reports table names the report; exact endpoint spelling and Canada validation remain to be confirmed in the API Explorer.

assertions: Total debits equal total credits within tolerance.
knownDiscrepancies: Exact endpoint spelling is not accepted until per-report reference review.

reports.name: General Ledger
reports.businessQuestion: Which posting transactions explain each account balance during a period?

applicability.notes: GeneralLedger is identified as a Reports API resource; exact Canada behaviour remains pending.

assertions: Opening balance plus period activity equals closing balance for selected control accounts.

reports.name: Statement of Cash Flows
reports.businessQuestion: How did operating, investing, and financing activity change cash during the period?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; Canada/connected-company validation is pending.

assertions: Opening cash plus net change equals closing cash within tolerance.

reports.name: Accounts Receivable Aging
reports.businessQuestion: Which customers owe money and how overdue are their balances?

applicability.notes: Candidate critical report; endpoint and Canada availability require exact report reference review.

assertions: Total aging agrees to the receivable control balance within scope and tolerance.

reports.name: Accounts Payable Aging
reports.businessQuestion: Which vendors are owed money and how overdue are the balances?

applicability.notes: Candidate critical report; endpoint and Canada availability require exact report reference review.

assertions: Total aging agrees to the payable control balance within scope and tolerance.

reports.name: Sales by Customer Summary
reports.businessQuestion: Which customer segments produce revenue during the period?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; Canada validation is pending.

assertions: Customer totals roll to the applicable sales total within documented scope.

reports.name: Income by Customer Summary
reports.businessQuestion: How is income distributed across customers and project-oriented work?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; project/report semantics need validation.

assertions: Customer income totals agree to the corresponding scoped income total within tolerance.

reports.name: Sales by Product/Service Summary
reports.businessQuestion: Which products and services generate sales?

applicability.notes: Reports API endpoint is documented; Canada validation is pending.

assertions: Item sales totals roll to the applicable sales total within documented scope.

reports.name: Sales by Class Summary
reports.businessQuestion: How do sales differ across approved operating classes?

applicability.notes: Endpoint is documented and requires class tracking plus populated class data.

assertions: Class totals and unclassified amounts reconcile to the applicable scoped sales total.

reports.name: Inventory Valuation Summary
reports.businessQuestion: What inventory quantity and value does the company hold at a point in time?

applicability.notes: Endpoint is documented and requires inventory support plus populated inventory items.

assertions: Inventory total agrees to the scoped inventory asset control balance within tolerance.

reports.name: Inventory Valuation Detail
reports.businessQuestion: Which transactions explain inventory quantity and value changes?

applicability.notes: Endpoint is documented and requires inventory support plus lifecycle transactions.

assertions: Detail movements roll to the summary for the same scope and date.

reports.name: Project Profitability
reports.businessQuestion: Which projects are profitable after related income, costs, and time?

applicability.notes: Projects are documented for Advanced, but the exact report/API availability and partner entitlement require review.

assertions: Project income less project costs equals project profit within tolerance.

reports.name: Sales Tax Liability
reports.businessQuestion: What tax was collected, recoverable, adjusted, and payable for the filing period?

applicability.notes: Exact Canadian report name, API endpoint, and filing relationships require current classification.

expectedNonZero: Net liability where blueprint calls for it
assertions: Report amounts reconcile to scoped tax control accounts and managed taxable lifecycles within tolerance.

reports.name: Budget vs Actual
reports.businessQuestion: How does actual performance compare with the approved plan?

applicability.notes: Product, API, and exact report availability remain unclassified.

assertions: Actual totals agree to the corresponding financial report scope.

reports.name: Reconciliation Summary and Evidence
reports.businessQuestion: Does the recorded account balance agree with the approved statement and outstanding items?

applicability.notes: Exact QBO report/API availability is not established; manual evidence may be required.

assertions: Statement balance plus or minus documented outstanding items agrees to the scoped book balance.
Evidence state never claims official QBO completion from inference alone.
